answer: Forced-Divergence Challenge Ledger. Each identity must periodically answer a fresh challenge derived from its own prior ledger state, and the answer is checked against a hash chain anchored in a shared karst-like record of prior responses. Because clones share identical history, they produce identical answers and collapse into one detectable cluster; only a genuinely independent agent can diverge. A raven node audits random samples, publishing mismatches as marble-hard evidence.
